notes.title: Be Vigilant! UE5 update
notes.notes:
Be Vigilant in UE5 is now live!

After months of hard work Be Vigilant! has been updated from UE4 4.25 to UE5 5.0.3
with of bug fixes and improvements

Here is a list of whats new:

Upgraded to UE5: Be Vigilant! has never looked better
More chats and story added
Emotes on the num+pad for fun communication
Currency re-balanced and store inventories expanded
New quests
XP book gives player experience
New sound effects added
More undead varieties
New maps in act 2 and 3
New areas in old maps


Plans for the next patch:

Upgrading to the latest version of UE5
An input re-map so players can choose control schemes
The remaining 5 maps
Upgrading came with some minor problems that we are working on. Some physics assets and textures may be incorrect. Stretching rag-dolls and grey grid material may show up. Things like this have started to be addressed but will need more testing to get all incorrect assets reconfigured. 
There is an occasional disconnection from the server when traveling to a new level. Simply re-join the server to get back to playing. This problem is fickle and we are still trying to zero in on the issue. 

There are secrets throughout the game for the ones that like to explore. We hope you and your friends enjoy our adventure! 

Keep your score high and your deaths low. No one has made it through with zero deaths. Will you be the first!? Be Vigilant!

notes.title: Big upgrade coming soon
notes.notes: We have been working on something special. We are going to upgrade Be Vigilant! very soon. Something new for BV! Keep on the look out for this next update!

notes.title: Tactical view testing version 1
notes.notes: Testing starting out in "always third-person" mode. When playing you can turn on top down camera swapping when outdoors. "Tactical camera". Also some small fixes with animation, camera view and audio.

notes.title: Always third person option.
notes.notes: This patch adds the always third person option. From the options menu, open controls and click the always third person button. You can toggle this option by clicking the button again.

notes.title: Act 2 and 3 are under construction and playable
notes.notes: It has been over a year since an update was published. Entering Be Vigilant! into the game development world championship has pushed us hard to make more of the game available to play. Act 2 and Act 3 take the game from a wasteland to a robot controlled city and eventually to a cyberpunk city. These new levels are untested, in need of lots of work and the content is not complete. There are still several levels in the later acts yet to be included. The original Act 1 has been massively improved. The game can take over several hours to play through with friends in its current state. There are new features like a true top down view and others coming online soon like a third person all the time option. We look forward to getting player feedback to improve this massive project.

notes.title: Keeping it going.
notes.notes: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34875146/fec762a5a18dc7f8f349fee3fef4b98cb7429a3a.png[/img]We haven't posted or updated in a while. We are making some small fixes and working on the beginning of Act 2, Robot city.

notes.title: Be Vigilant!
notes.notes:
Be Vigilant! is finally here. The early accesses version has been uploaded and ready for sale. Act 1 features 11 co-op maps for an online or offline campaign. Fight your way across this Dead Earth to save your people. Included will also be the experimental PvP mode where you can test your skills against other players. Its been a long journey and the game has come along way. We still have a long way to go, but to achieve this milestone seemed at some point impossible. Thank you to everyone who helped test and push us along the way.

Continued fixes and update coming as we processes feedback from release. Any suggestions or bug reports can be sent to Zerothornstudios@gmial.com. Thank you for playing and remember to Be Vigilant!

notes.title: Release version uploaded
notes.notes:
This is the version that will be launched for early access on the 25th. Let the final rounds of beta testing commence! 

    All new animations and a vehicle system overhaul a week before launch.... what could go wrong. Good luck testers and remember to always Be Vigilant!

notes.title: Closed Beta is Live!
notes.notes:
This is the beginning of the Closed Beta. A select few have been chosen to help iron out the remaining wrinkles. We thank all who are participating and will expand the list as soon as possible. Good luck and happy hunting! 

Official release date announcement coming soon...

notes.title: Steam Upload Day! Happy Halloween!!!
notes.notes: This is the first upload of Be Vigilant! to Steam Works for closed beta testing. One small step as a developer, One giant leap for Be Vigilant!.
